description: Read several of a merchant's products in one call. Omit product_ids for the merchant's whole listed catalogue (a single query); supply product_ids (max 100) to read a named subset, fetched concurrently. Results come back in the order asked for. An id with no listed product appears under not_found and an id whose read failed appears under errors, both alongside the products that were read — one bad id never costs the rest of the catalogue. Only LISTED products are returned: a product the merchant has delisted appears in neither list, and its on-chain record is the authoritative view of it.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

product_ids.description: Optional 0x-prefixed bytes32 ids; omit for the merchant's whole listed catalogue

name: get_products
